basis: retained successful GitHub Actions artifacts of five green main CI runs; no new instrumentation, no source/test/runner changes
metric_warning: sum_durations_s is the SUM OF PER-FILE DURATIONS under within-shard parallel execution. It is NOT runner wall time, NOT a median, NOT a p95, and NOT expected PR elapsed time.

baseline.note: baseline; attempt 2 re-ran only failed test (1)

excluded.exclusion_reason: attempt-1 execution of shard 1 ended in a file failure (tests/test-tool-coordinator-duration.rkt); superseded by the successful attempt-2 re-run artifact 14401705110. Retained here as a flagged exclusion; never mixed into any aggregate.

provenance.ambiguity_policy: one authoritative successful artifact per (SHA, run attempt, shard); validated shard index/total, suite, pass/fail summary and per-shard file-count (443); ambiguity resolved by provenance + result truth; ambiguous or failed artifacts excluded and recorded

runs.note: baseline; attempt 2 re-ran only failed test (1)

cost_field_definitions.per_file_duration: files[].duration_seconds emitted by run-tests per file (cumulative wall of that file's own execution)
cost_field_definitions.sum_durations_s: arithmetic sum of per_file_duration over all selected files; exceeds wall time because 4 files execute in parallel inside each shard
cost_field_definitions.preparation_cost: extra.prepared_environment.preparation_elapsed_ms (closure preparation inside the job) and restore_ms (prepared-env restore)
cost_field_definitions.dispatch_latency_s: job started_at minus the start of the job's own run attempt; conflates needs-graph waiting with runner availability (GitHub exposes no per-attempt start for earlier attempts; created_at used as labeled proxy)

cross_version_lane_baseline.duplicate_execution_note: re-executes the entire 1329-file fast suite per main push

environment_per_run.workflow_definition: unchanged across the five head SHAs (no .github/ diff in fde734da..22851554)
